## Immutable basis
`d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`: 18 Python modules; 111 editable blocks (66 leading docstrings, 45 maximal full-line comment regions); 14,837 base words (`\b[\w][\w’'-]*\b`). Retired `9e65567b…` ranges map by owner/code identity, not lines. All blobs equal local `origin/main@4c9940348148fb255b17ddf1cb124701ad4565d7`.

## Boundary and stable allowlist
Paths are under `src/rebar/_store/`. Only listed blocks/adjacent blanks may change. `D:<owner>` is a leading string expression; `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` a maximal region before unchanged code; `:occN` separates repeats. Full ID: `<path>#<ID>`.
- `canonical.py` — `D:<module>`; retain canonical JSON/integers and bytes/string helpers.
- `ensures.py` — `D:{<module>,run_ensures}; C:<module>:before:{import:rebar._store,REGISTRY_IDS,_pending_cache}; C:run_ensures:before:raise`; retain stable IDs, locked sweeps, incompatibility, and pending hint.
- `env_identity.py` — `D:{<module>,mint_env_id_guarded,ensure_env_id_unit,divergence_report}`; retain local identity, loud minting, bounded evidence, and author divergence.
- `event_append.py` — `D:{<module>,_deferred_maintenance,delete_events,batch_write_and_push,_rollback_batch,_recover_from_unmerged,_is_invalid_object_error,_recover_from_invalid_object}; C:stage_and_commit:before:{_unstage,add_err,healed+detail,healed}; C:write_and_push:before:try; C:_recover_from_unmerged:before:{foreign,retry}; C:<module>:before:_INVALID_OBJECT_MARKERS; C:_recover_from_invalid_object:before:staged_before`; retain lock/atomicity, scoped prune/rollback, conflict and poisoned-index recovery.

## Protected material / consumers
Excluded as concise/policy-load-bearing (17 blocks): `ensures.py#D:EnsureOutcome; C:<module>:before:{APPLIED_MARKER,HINTED_MARKER}`; `event_append.py#D:_staged_index_paths; C:write_and_push:before:_maybe_enrich_drain; C:<module>:before:_recover_from_invalid_object`; `event_commit_git.py#C:<module>:before:{_run_git,_git_commit}`; `git_locking.py#C:_reclaim_if_stale_index_lock:before:lock_file`; `gitutil.py#C:<module>:before:run_git_write`; `lock_owner.py#C:<module>:before:_STAMP_UNKNOWN; C:_process_start_time:before:if:len`; `lock.py#D:_retry_backoff_s; C:write_lock_is_busy:before:return:is_contention`; `push_recovery.py#C:<module>:before:{_stash_create,_restore_stash,_resolve_conflicted_apply}`. The retired `_is_transient_add_error` comment is absent at the basis and is not a target. Preserve the other 222 prose blocks, all inline comments/runtime strings/regexes/prompts/assertions/data, and executable AST. Keep 15 directive and 0 shebang lines exact with inline/next-code attachment. `push.py` re-exports `_resolve_conflicted_apply`; `test_get_rotation_heldout.py` requires `get_rotation.json` in its docstring. No other allowlisted docstring has a runtime reader.

## Independent receipt
Require exactly 111 non-author, leaf-linked TSV rows:
`stable_id<TAB>full_before_SHA:path#ID<TAB>full_final_SHA:path#ID<TAB>contract_or_consumer<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>semantic_preservation<TAB>bloat_removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
Each needs `after_words < before_words` and PASS in all three verdict columns. Missing/duplicate/extra/author-reviewed/short-SHA/non-PASS rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 111 allowlisted blocks are shorter and retain every path contract/consumer.
- [ ] Parse parent/final with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; strip only allowlisted leading docstrings, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and match attribute-free AST dumps.
- [ ] Targets equal the leaf parent; protected prose/directives/shebangs match; zero-context hunks stay within resolved spans/adjacent blanks.
- [ ] `HEAD^..HEAD` changes exactly the 18 impacts; focused tests, scoped Ruff, hygiene, diff integrity, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify` pass.
- [ ] Exactly 111 fully cited non-author PASS rows exist.

## Verification
Run seven persisted DD rows: immutable-prose-only, exact-leaf-paths, focused-tests, scoped-ruff, comment-hygiene, diff-integrity, repository-gates.
